free_tier.stated: Pay-as-you-go with 'Free credits equivalent to 5 hours of Reverb ASR (free credits can be used for all products)'. Reverb Transcription is USD 0.20 an hour, so the grant is USD 1.00 of usage: 5 hours of Reverb English, or 200 minutes of Whisper Large at USD 0.005 a minute, or 333 minutes of Forced Alignment at USD 0.003 a minute.

record.interface_detail: HTTP API with reference documentation at docs.rev.ai/api, and official Java, Node and Python SDKs listed at docs.rev.ai/sdk
record.tooling: official Java, Node and Python SDKs (docs.rev.ai/sdk); the page names no CLI
record.chaining: Five hours of Reverb provides audio transcription allowance with a 15-second minimum per audio clip. The grant is denominated in hours for a single model and does not transfer to alternative models.

limits.value: USD 1.00 of credit is the whole allowance: five hours of the cheapest English model, or three hours twenty minutes if the work needs Whisper Large, and nothing renews.

record.notes: These are inference credits, not general compute. The direct read of rev.ai/pricing returned a JavaScript shell with no price text; the quotes above come from the search index rendering of the same vendor URL on the same day, which is the vendor's text but retrieved indirectly. A third-party review (aiappstacker.com) reported the same 5-hour grant, corroborating it. Not established: whether a card is demanded at signup.
